 Boucher makes NHL debut 
 Wednesday, November 4th 
 Boucher makes NHL debut 
 Former Wichita Thunder forward Dillon Boucher became the   785th former ECHL player   to reach the National Hockey League when he debuted with the Chicago Blackhawks on Wednesday against the Florida Panthers. 
 Boucher is the   third former ECHL player   to make his NHL debut during the 2026-27 season. He played his first three pro seasons with the Thunder, recording 35 points (14g-21a) in 151 career games. 
 A native of Head Chezzetcook, Nova Scotia, Boucher has posted eight points (3g-5a) in 60 career games with Rockford of the American Hockey League.
